translator.structuralFrontend: formal-ai lexer with Router opaque-literal extensions
translator.pipeline: Rust syntax → serialized/reparsed checked semantic IR → JavaScript/TypeScript
extensions: checked Rust strings and scalar domain
Rust raw literals and ASCII continuation normalization
checked mutable scalar control flow and immutable slice indexing
module-local immutable records and algebraic constructors
lazy typed scalar iterators, contextual closures and bounded integer ranges
checked standard-library filesystem/environment reads, lazy async futures and identity-error propagation

semantics.integerEncoding: BigInt with checked fixed-width arithmetic; usize/isize assume 64 bits
assumptions: Rust integer arithmetic uses checked overflow behavior (debug/test profile); release wrapping arithmetic is outside this draft contract
String case conversion depends on the source and host Unicode tables
const fn is lowered for pure runtime calls only; compile-time evaluability is not established
Immutable strings encode scalar values; monomorphic tagged values encode Option/Result; vectors/slices are immutable arrays
semantics.observation: checked value results, local scalar mutation, immutable constructors, lazy future polling and named host effects; carried items supply no executable behavior
